title: GOALS and missions
summary: The GOALS panel lists what the current mission asks for. Tick them off to move the story on.
text:
The **GOALS** panel at the top of the screen shows the mission under way and its objectives. The one to do next is lit; done ones are ticked. Finish them all and the mission pays out (often alloys, sometimes a hint about what to do next) and the next mission starts.

The first few missions are a tutorial: power, mining, the first night, your first colonist and exploring. After that the story opens up and missions take you further afield.

- A mission in another region shows that region's name, its objectives greyed until you go there
- Countdowns the story starts show under the goals with a ⏱
- Some missions can fail, so keep an eye on what they ask you to protect

When an expedition's mission is done, a card closes the chapter on that place. **Head home** travels back to Touchdown; **Stay a while** keeps you there (the Command Core's card has the way home whenever you want it).
